decisions.reason: As a small extension of the established radiant-heating business, it is easy to retain and any weak uptake can be framed as temporary while the firm protects prior engineering effort.
This visible multi-model electric line fits the move toward broader lower-carbon climate solutions, so management is likely to continue backing it rather than reverse a public launch quickly.

Although this electric halogen heater is somewhat less central and may overlap with other electric offerings, the recent launch and public product page still make management more likely to persist than withdraw.

This industrial electric hall-heater line is close to the core customer base and was launched visibly, so a growing machinery firm with in-house R&D would likely keep it and wait for adoption to build.

Because the hydrogen-capable heater matches the firm's announced strategic direction toward hydrogen-ready lower-carbon heating, management has strong incentive to justify and maintain the commitment.
